risk_note: F1-08ah (orchestrator D10-1517 batch 1 item 1, first of three; D10-1523, D10-1525, D10-1543, D10-1554, D10-1559). The admin withdrawal detail page gets 审核通过 and 驳回: approve sends POST /admin/v1/withdrawals/batch-approve with only this withdrawal (the contract has no single approve), reject sends POST /admin/v1/withdrawals/{id}/reject with one of the five manual reason codes and an optional note; both go through the shared StepUpModal (totp tier, BR-ID-34) and are sent once, 10003 asks for the code again, 20902 refreshes, 20001 shows the fields / reason; the buttons show only with withdraw.review and a reviewable status and stay shown when the member has holds (blocking is the server's W2 guard, BR-WDR-10 / BR-WDR-05); a skipped result never shows a success message. Under each reason the user copy comes only from withdraw_reject_reason.<CODE>.title (CT-26zo #72); a missing key shows the code's Chinese name, no hard-coded text. Four frozen F1-08a read-only cases change (rule_change): READONLY#2, READONLY#3 and BROWSER#1 exclude only these two buttons from the write-entry ban (D10-1523, br BR-WDR-10); SOURCE#1 drops only its no-step-up line (D10-1543, br BR-WDR-10 and BR-ID-34); every other assertion stays. Rule tests by Codex in several rounds; independent Claude spec-test r1 void (exit 12, branch moved), r2 fail (S1 holds fixture, S2 false success), r3 pass after Codex added both; the frozen-case edits by Codex (not the F1-08a writer); DICT#1 key renamed to .title and DICT#2 added for the missing-key fallback (D10-1554, not counted). Red on couli-ci for spec commit 55d5ee4ce (19 tests, right reason). Implementation by Opus 5.5 in two rounds (r2 removed a hard-coded BR-TEXT-08 fallback); couli-ci --tests admin-withdrawal-review 19/19 green and --browser green; run.ts static 10/10. Codex money review r1 pass, r2 pass with one S2: [AC-F1-08ah-DICT#2] line 100 asserts toContain('风险嫌疑') instead of the exact full text. Tightening it hit the per-task Codex limit (task_calls 10, 规划/11 §2.5); by D10-1559 this lands as is and the tightening is follow-up FU-F108AH-DICT2-EXACT (tighten_only, Codex, to toBe('风险嫌疑（RISK_SUSPECT）用户看到：风险嫌疑')), ahead of the next page task. The same case still asserts that neither the BR-TEXT-08 default sentence nor the dictionary test sentence appears. Written by hand.
